subject: ela
intro: An author makes a point and gives reasons for it. A reason tells WHY. Kindergartners find the reason the author gives.

items.prompt:
Read.

You should wear a helmet. It keeps your head safe.

What reason is given?

steps: The point is to wear a helmet.
The reason tells why: it keeps your head safe.
So the reason is that it keeps your head safe.

items.prompt:
Read.

We should drink water. It helps our body.

What reason is given for drinking water?

steps: The reason tells why we drink water: it helps our body.
So the reason is it helps our body.

items.prompt:
Read.

Recycling is good. It keeps the earth clean.

Why is recycling good?

steps: The reason: it keeps the earth clean.
So recycling is good because it keeps the earth clean.
